Best Of All Possible Worlds - Socrates Sculpture Garden, NY. Saul Melman, 2011
The architectural floorplan of a New York apartment is mapped out with vacuum-formed plastic doors. The doors function as a fixed idea in the fluid, outdoor sculptural experience.
The daily movement of the sun across the Park alters the viewers’ experience of the work, and imbues ephemerality to the architecture beyond the Park setting.
A second iteration was installed at the deCordova Sculpture Park and Museum in Lincoln, Conn.
